digest: HEAD 654f639 changes three externally observable behaviors: it renames the public terminal-summary field launchRetryAttempts to launchRetries, widens cancellation classification to accept 'cancelled' and 'timeout', and changes the stop-poll default to 200ms. The rename is a breaking change for consumers, and the cancellation widening is a behavior change. Neither is covered by a test, and SPEC.md contradicts the code. Not deployable as-is without a compatibility decision.

impacts.description: WorkflowTerminalSummary.launchRetryAttempts was renamed to launchRetries. SPEC T3 declares launchRetryAttempts a public contract read by external tools. The old field no longer appears in src/, so any consumer reading it gets undefined, a silent break.
impacts.migration: Emit both fields for one release (launchRetryAttempts deprecated, launchRetries new), or revert the rename and document the new name separately. Update SPEC T3 to match whichever is chosen.

impacts.description: isWorkflowReturnedCancellation now treats the strings 'cancelled' and 'timeout' as cancellation. SPEC C1 allows only aborted, AbortError, and ABORT_ERR. A provider timeout error may now be reclassified as a user cancellation, which changes downstream terminal status. Whether real provider payloads use these markers is unverified (u5 in implementation-map).
impacts.migration: Confirm the provider payload shapes that produce 'cancelled'/'timeout'. If 'timeout' is a failure rather than a cancel, drop it from the accepted set. Otherwise add a test and update SPEC C1.

impacts.description: createWorkflowStopSignal default pollMs is now 200ms. SPEC S3 says 50ms, and says values below 10ms are clamped. Code clamps with Math.max(1, ...), not 10. Stop-request latency rises up to about 200ms. Callers relying on the spec default see different timing.
impacts.migration: Decide whether 200ms is intended. If yes, update S3 and the clamp floor; if no, restore 50. Document the default as part of the exported signature.

impacts.description: SPEC Q1 requires a unit test per S/C/T item. None were found, so the contract changes above have no automated guard against drift.
impacts.migration: Add contract tests for the launchRetries field name, cancellation marker set, and poll default before release.

assumptions.note: The changed-file list comes from the commit message and grep, not from git diff. The exact diff of 654f639 was not read.
store.js and types.js are not in the repo, so readWorkflowStopIntent and WorkflowRunRecord shape are unverified.
No external consumer of launchRetryAttempts or launchRetries was visible from this repo. Consumer impact is inferred from SPEC T3.
Whether SPEC.md was changed by HEAD is unconfirmed. Mismatches are treated as code-vs-spec drift.
